tasks.label: Run Java Ready Web App
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path out | Out-Null; javac --add-modules jdk.httpserver -d out src\placementprep\Main.java src\placementprep\model\*.java src\placementprep\quiz\*.java src\placementprep\service\*.java src\placementprep\web\*.java; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { java --add-modules jdk.httpserver -cp out placementprep.web.PlacementPrepServer }
